description: c / a - b not folded to 4 - b although the range assumptions make c / a constant (regression since LLVM 20)
notes: C adapted from the issue's C reproducer (same IR as the issue's literal version). With a in [39, 46] and c in [184, 194], c / a is always 4, and LLVM 20 emitted 4 - b; clang trunk keeps the udiv (narrowed to i8). expected.ll from the issue's LLVM 20 output (sub nuw nsw 4, b), with the three assumes kept. expected.ll proven correct (refinement) by Alive2 alive-tv, 2026-10-28: src = clang trunk -O3 IR of src.c (godbolt cclang_trunk, -O3 --target=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -march=skylake -emit-llvm -S -g0) renamed @src, tgt = expected.ll renamed @tgt, identical signature; output 'Transformation seems to be correct!' with no warning. Run on Alive2's own Compiler Explorer instance (alive2.llvm.org/ce, compiler id 'alive'), since godbolt.org does not host alive-tv.
